text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 23, 2024) for 317-319 The Kingsway.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Amended the By-law Section of Item 1 on the Property Standards Order (October 23, 2024) for 317-319 The Kingsway, Folder Number 24 229863 PRS 00 IV to 19.D.(3)(g)[1][b] OR 19.D.(3)(g)[2]. 2. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 23, 2024) for 317-319 The Kingsway, Folder Number 24 229863 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to October 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
